messages:
alex: Quick idea thread \— propose we standardize SDK connection modes to two explicit patterns: 'unary/stateless' and 'session/stateful'. Keep default as unary for web/PLG.

sasha: I like two explicit patterns. unary default reduces firewall/proxy issues.

jun: Implementation note for Go: make session API iterator/channel-first; avoid forcing callback style. Python/TS: async iterator + context manager seems natural.

maya: Important: retry semantics differ by mode. unary = optimistic retries with idempotency semantics. session = conservative: by default don't auto-retry non-idempotent calls (explicit idempotency flag required).

alex: Agree. Proposal: client config exposes: default_mode (unary|session), idempotency_override per-call, retry_policy with sensible defaults, and hedging toggle for high-p99 endpoints.

sasha: Transport: make HTTP/2 server-streaming primary. For browsers use websocket or chunked-response fallback. Avoid proprietary TCP protocol.

alex: Handshake sketch we can document for SDKs:
``
client -> server: { type: "handshake", client_sdk, mode: "session", want_resume:true, opts }
server -> client: { session_id, resume_token, acknowledged_opts }
```
Resume token opaque, server-controlled. SDKs must treat resume token as an opaque string.

maya: Resume TTL: soft-expire by message sequence (server rejects resume if sequence gap > N), hard-expire after inactivity window (e.g., 20 minutes). Document both.

jun: Token versioning: prefix opaque tokens with version marker (e.g. v1|...). Server should detect old version and return clear error to force fresh session/page retrieval.

alex: Pagination shape: keep page-token-first-class (customers store tokens) and provide iterator wrappers in SDK. Do not hide tokens entirely.

maya: On backoff: default = jittered exponential, base 200ms, max 8s, max attempts 5 for unary, 3 for session. Allow override via client config.

jun: For stream/session mode we need clear guidance for KV cache correctness guarantees and ordering semantics. Document: session binds to a server-side KV cache instance; resume only valid while cache still present. If cache evicted, server returns resume-miss error.

alex: Telemetry: SDKs should emit events for retries, resume attempts (success/failure), and token rejection with reason. This will feed Optimize/Console.

maya: Also add opt-in hedged-requests for read-heavy, high-p99 endpoints. Default off. If enabled, emit telemetry when hedging activates.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: handshake v2 toggles enabled in staging at 2024-10-02T15:24:12Z :rocket:

sasha: I'll draft a short RFC with examples for Python/TS/Go (handshake snippets, iterator vs page-token usage, and recommended defaults). Ping @jun @maya for API shape review.

alex: If no blockers by EOD I'll land the small shim and open SDK PRs. :thumbsup:
